high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing in front of a dark background with a metallic structure that has the word "RODLAVE" partially visible. The individual is dressed in traditional attire, which includes a white turban adorned with a feather or decorative element on top. They are wearing a long-sleeved white kurta (a type of tunic) with a layered design, paired with white dhoti pants. A gold necklace with a prominent pendant is worn around their neck, adding a touch of elegance to the outfit. The person is also wearing white sneakers with black accents.
